steps.title: Initialize Android Project
steps.description: Set up the basic directory structure for a new Android application.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Files
steps.description: Define project-level and app-level Gradle settings, including SDK versions and dependencies.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Define the core properties of the application, including its package name, components, and permissions.

steps.title: Design Main Layout
steps.description: Create the XML layout for the primary activity (MainActivity), defining the user interface elements.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Java Code
steps.description: Develop the Java code for MainActivity, handling UI logic and lifecycle events.

steps.title: Define Application Name
steps.description: Specify the user-facing name of the application in the string resources.

steps.title: Configure Styles and Themes
steps.description: Set up the visual theme for the application, ensuring a consistent look and feel.

steps.title: Prepare for Icon
steps.description: Ensure the manifest references the default icon drawable which will be provided by the build system.

steps.title: Synchronize Gradle Project
steps.description: Run Gradle sync to ensure all dependencies are resolved and the project structure is recognized.

steps.title: Building SimpleApp
steps.description: Compile the source code and resources into an installable APK package.
